summary: May is spring at its best in much of Europe and North America, before the summer crowds arrive.
intro: Long, mild days and green countryside make May one of the best months for much of Europe, from the Mediterranean to the first light nights of Scandinavia. Most sights are open, and prices are lower than in July and August.
In South Asia the heat is at its peak before the monsoon. Across much of southern Africa the dry season begins, the start of the best months for safaris there.
